page.title: Minimum Age Policy for Yacht Charter in Marbella: 2039 Guide

data.meta_description: Minimum age yacht charter Marbella 2039: 18+ to rent, 0+ to ride. No licence needed for skippered charters. Book your family day out today.
data.summary: This guide explains the minimum age policy for yacht charter in Marbella in 2039: you must be 18+ to charter, but all ages can ride. No licence required on skippered boats, making it easy for families to enjoy the Costa del Sol.
key_facts: Minimum age to charter a boat in Marbella is 18 (with valid ID).
No minimum age for passengers – infants and children welcome.
No boating licence needed on any skippered charter in our fleet.
All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella.
Prices start from €749 for 2 hours (Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39).
Skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT included.
Larger vessels like the Mangusta 80 require a minimum 4-hour booking.

faq.q: What is the minimum age to rent a yacht in Marbella?
faq.a: You must be at least 18 years old to charter a yacht in Marbella. We require a valid passport or national ID card at check-in. There is no upper age limit.

faq.q: Can children come on a yacht charter in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes, absolutely. There is no minimum age for passengers. Infants, toddlers, and teenagers are all welcome. Life jackets are available for all sizes, and our skippers ensure a safe, family-friendly environment.

faq.q: Do I need a boating licence to charter a yacht in Marbella?
faq.a: No. All our charters include a licensed skipper who handles navigation, docking, and safety. You do not need any licence or prior experience – just relax and enjoy.

faq.q: Can a 17-year-old rent a boat with a skipper?
faq.a: No, the charter contract must be signed by someone aged 18 or over. If you are 17, you can come as a passenger, but an adult (18+) must book and be present on board.

faq.q: What ID do I need to prove my age for a yacht charter?
faq.a: A valid passport or national identity card (EU or non-EU) is required. A driving licence is accepted only if it includes a photo and date of birth. No photocopies – original only.

faq.q: Are there age restrictions for jet skis or water toys?
faq.a: Jet skis are available on the Mangusta 80 charter (4h minimum). The minimum age to drive a jet ski in Spain is 16, and you must hold a valid PWC licence. Passengers can ride from age 6 with a life jacket.

faq.q: What is the youngest age for a child to go on a yacht charter?
faq.a: There is no official minimum. Infants of any age are welcome. We recommend bringing a baby life jacket (available on request) and sun protection. The sea is generally calm in Marbella's bay.

faq.q: Can a group of under-18s charter a yacht without an adult?
faq.a: No. At least one person in the group must be 18 or over to sign the charter agreement. That adult will be legally responsible for the group during the trip.

data.body_html:
Planning a yacht charter in Marbella in 2039 and wondering about age rules? You are not alone. The minimum age yacht charter Marbella 2039 policy is straightforward: you must be at least 18 years old to charter a boat, but there is no minimum age for passengers. Whether you are bringing toddlers, teenagers, or grandparents, everyone is welcome aboard. And because every charter includes a licensed skipper, no boating licence is required. This guide covers everything you need to know – from ID requirements to family-friendly options – so you can book with confidence.

Minimum Age to Charter a Yacht in Marbella

To rent any boat from our fleet – whether it is the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) or the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) – you must be at least 18 years old. This is a legal requirement under Spanish maritime regulations. We check ID at check-in: a valid passport or national ID card is required. No exceptions. If you are under 18, you can still enjoy the trip as a passenger, but an adult must book and be present on board.

No Minimum Age for Passengers

Families love Marbella for its calm waters and child-friendly atmosphere. There is no minimum age for passengers – infants, children, and teenagers are all welcome. Life jackets are available for all sizes, and our skippers are trained to ensure a safe environment. Popular family boats include the Lagoon 380 catamaran (11.6m, 10 pax) and the Azimut 39 (11 pax). Both depart from Puerto Banús and include soft drinks, water, and snacks.

Do You Need a Boating Licence?

No. Every charter includes a professional skipper who handles navigation, docking, and safety. You do not need any licence or prior experience. This is one of the biggest advantages of skippered charters in Marbella – you can simply relax, swim, and enjoy the views of La Concha mountain and the Golden Mile. The only exception is if you want to drive a jet ski (available on the Mangusta 80), which requires a PWC licence and minimum age of 16.

Age Rules for Specific Boats in Our Fleet

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax): minimum charter age 18, no passenger age limit.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax): same policy.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax): minimum charter age 18, jet ski driver must be 16+ with licence.
  • Speedboat (7m, 6 pax): minimum charter age 18, no passenger limit.
  • Dubhe (8m, 5 pax): ideal for small families, same age rules.

What ID Is Accepted?

We accept a valid passport or national ID card (original only). A driving licence is accepted only if it includes a photo and date of birth. No photocopies or digital scans. If you are chartering on behalf of a group, the person signing the contract must present their own ID. For passengers, no ID is required – but we recommend carrying it for coastal patrol checks.

Family-Friendly Charter Tips for Marbella

Marbella's coastline offers calm anchorages like Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés, perfect for swimming with children. Most charters include snorkel gear and floaties on request. We recommend booking a half-day (4 hours) or full-day (8 hours) to explore Cabopino or Estepona. The sea temperature in summer reaches 24°C, and the breeze keeps everyone comfortable. All our boats have shaded areas and onboard toilets.
